headline: Trump on Oil Profits Amid Iran Conflict
detail: Political pressure on oil companies could impact energy sector sentiment. For your tech/chip heavy portfolio, sustained high oil prices (due to conflict) mean higher operational costs for businesses and less discretionary spending for consumers, which can indirectly hurt tech demand.
rec: No action. This is a general economic watch, not a direct trade signal for your tech holdings.

headline: California Diesel Prices Jump, National Ripple Effects
detail: Rising diesel costs directly increase transportation and logistics expenses across all industries. This inflationary pressure can squeeze corporate margins and reduce consumer purchasing power, potentially impacting the broader market and your tech holdings.
rec: No action. This reinforces the general economic concern from high oil prices, but doesn't warrant a specific trade on your tech/chip names.
